notes.title: VIVE Streaming (2.2.4a) | VIVE Ultimate tracker (1.2.3) beta patch
notes.notes:
VIVE Streaming – 2.2.4a – BETA release note
 Released January 24, 2025
 
VIVE Streaming (2.2.4a)
•	[OpenXR] Fixed an issue which causing OpenXR content to have lower FPS performance due to unexpected error logs.
 
*****   
 
VIVE Ultimate Tracker – 1.2.3 – BETA release note
 Released January 24, 2025
 
VIVE Ultimate Tracker (1.2.3)
•	Fixed an issue when VIVE Hub is not on the top window, which could cause significant latency in pose updating.
•	Fixed an issue that prevented continuing map scanning after tracking was lost.
•	Fixed missing refine button when any of the map scanning results are in red.

notes.title: VIVE Hub – 2.3.3b – Public release note
notes.notes:
VIVE Hub – 2.3.3b – Public release note
Released January 15, 2025

VIVE Hub (2.3.3b)
•	Added a tip on the recommended setup for better eye and facial tracking in VRChat.
•	Added a tip on how to properly plug in and secure the VIVE Wired Streaming Cable to the headset.
 
*****   
 
VIVE Streaming – 2.2.4 – PUBLIC release note
Released January 15, 2025

VIVE Streaming (2.2.4)
•	Added support to align headset boundary colors in DisplayPort mode
•	Added low battery alerts in DisplayPort mode
•	Fixed screen tearing issues in 120fps DisplayPort mode
•	Fixed an issue where the Mixed Reality option would remain disabled after server restart
•	Enhanced wireless streaming performance in low bandwidth conditions
•	Enhanced screen recording quality in DisplayPort mode
•	Enhanced frame control during network traffic
•	Improved headset motion prediction in DisplayPort mode
•	Reduced eye tracking initialization time after reconnection
•	[Enterprise] Added Lock Console feature

VIVE Streaming app (1.1.23.3)
•	Improved stability and prevented potential crashes
 
*****   
 
VIVE Desk – 1.3.5b – PUBLIC release note
Released January 15, 2025

VIVE Desk (1.3.5b)
•	Improved connection stability
•	You can now add more screens to your desktop
•	Updated the screen layout for better screen management
•	Added support for WebView

VIVE Desk app (1.0.1.15)
•	Refined UI sizing for clearer viewing
•	Introducing Canvas: a new way to arrange monitor and window layouts
•	Added web widget functionality for browsing without creating additional monitors
•	Redesigned keyboard for VR input
 
*****   
 
VIVE Ultimate Tracker runtime – 1.2.1 – PUBLIC release note
Released January 15, 2025

Changes:
•	Added scale mode support to the VIVE space calibration
•	Improved map synchronization success rate
•	Fixed trackpad button input issue via POGO pin
